title: List pages
description: Returns HTTP 200 with {pages, nextCursor}. Filter with roomId and includeResolved; limit is 1 to 100 (default 50). Acknowledge with POST /api/pager/{id}/ack and resolve with POST /api/pager/{id}/resolve.
